mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with light drizzle reported near Harriet Park. Look for the moon phase as a waxing crescent tonight, and keep your eyes on the western sky over Mount Horeb at 7:36 PM to spot the space station traveling toward the northeast for five minutes.

The Verona Police Department has released a summary of calls for service from August 31 through September 14, which includes various traffic stops, an arrest for a serious O W I incident, and an ongoing investigation into a burglary.

It is a great time to be out in the community. Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee are both happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, or Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Among the noteworthy calls for service, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where an offender was quickly apprehended.
The Culver's store in Verona is closed today for a scheduled remodel, so plan your dining accordingly while they refresh the building.
